title: STEEL BALL RUN JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Anime's 'Special Video' Highlights Stands
content:
Warner Bros. Japan began streaming a new "special video" for the STEEL BALL RUN JoJo’s Bizarre Adventure anime on Tuesday. The video highlights the characters' Stands, the entity that manifests its owners' special abilities in the JoJo's Bizarre Adventure series. The video is available in both Japanese and English audio.

Japanese video:

English video:

The "first stage" of the anime of Hirohiko Araki 's JoJo's Bizarre Adventure Part 7: Steel Ball Run manga debuted on Netflix on March 19 with one 47-minute episode. Netflix is exclusively streaming the anime globally.

The anime stars:

• Shōgo Sakata as Johnny Joestar

• Yōhei Azakami as Gyro Zeppeli

• Kaito Ishikawa as Diego Brando

• Rie Takahashi as Lucy Steel

• Kenta Miyake as Steven Steel

• Masaaki Mizunaka as Sand Man

• Kenichirō Matsuda as Pocoloco

JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Golden Wind co-directors Yasuhiro Kimura and Hideya Takahashi are directing the anime at david production . Toshiyuki Kato ( JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Stone Ocean director who has also worked as a storyboarder and more on the other series in the franchise ) is the series director. Yasuko Kobayashi is returning from the other series in the franchise to oversee the series scripts, and Daisuke Tsumagari ( JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Golden Wind animation director) is designing the characters. Yūgo Kanno is again composing the music, and Yoshikazu Iwanami is returning as the sound director. Sub-character designers include: Yui Kinoshita , Grand Guerilla , Minoru Murao , and Chii .

Kroi performs the anime's opening theme song "Spin," while Yūki Chiba performs the anime's ending theme song "Shinu ka Ikiru ka" (To Die or Live) .

Viz Media has licensed the manga in English, and released the first volume digitally and in print in May 2025. Viz Media describes the first volume:

Riders from around the world gather in the Wild West for the race of the century! Johnny Joestar, a former jockey paralyzed from the waist down, comes to spectate, and momentarily regains the ability to walk while watching a duel fought by Gyro Zeppeli. Desperate to learn more about this power, Johnny joins the race alongside Gyro and embarks on the most epic and bizarre race to ever cross the American frontier!

Araki launched the manga in Shueisha 's Weekly Shonen Jump magazine in 2004, but the manga moved to Ultra Jump in 2005. The manga ended serialization in 2011, and had 24 volumes (consisting of volumes 81-104 of the overall JoJo's Bizarre Adventure (manga) .

david production 's anime adaptation that started by adapting Part 1 of the manga has covered the manga through Part 6, JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Stone Ocean . Netflix debuted the first 12 episodes of JoJo's Bizarre Adventure: Stone Ocean globally in December 2021. The second part of the anime consisting of episodes 13-24 debuted in September 2022 on Netflix . Netflix then debuted the third and final part , consisting of episodes 25-38, in December 2022.

Araki launched The JOJOLands manga , the ninth and latest part of his JoJo's Bizarre Adventure manga series, in Ultra Jump in February 2023.

Other recent entries in the franchise include video games, a stage musical , and live-action adaptations of Araki's spinoff manga Thus Spoke Kishibe Rohan ( Kishibe Rohan wa Ugokanai ).

title: 3 Things to Know for Spy x Family Season 4
content:
Almost a year after the third season reached its conclusion, Spy x Family finally confirmed a fourth season along with a new feature-length movie. The anime premiered its latest season in October last year as part of the Fall 2025 lineup, where it adapted some of the fan-favorite arcs. The latest season was a rollercoaster of emotions as it blended heartbreaking moments with nonsensical comedy as the main characters get involved in some of the most dangerous situations ever. However, the story is far from over, and Season 4 will bring new surprises and thrilling moments for fans. Based on Tatsua Endo’s beloved manga, Spy x Family follows the daily antics of the Forger Family.

While the story is finally taking shape, there are still a lot of loose ends to tie up, especially when it comes to the supposed main villain, Donovan Desmond. Each season brings fans one step closer to the truth. Apart from the fourth season, fans are also looking forward to the new movie, which might be non-canon, just like the 2023 movie, S py x Family Code: White . It’s only been three years since the massive success of the movie, and the studio is already going to expand the stellar world created by Endo. While you wait for the anime sequel, here are three things you need to know.

3) Spy x Family Will Reveal New Information in December 2026

The official website has already confirmed that Spy x Family will hold a panel at this year’s Jump Festa, which will be held on December 19th and 20th, 2026. The anime will hold a panel at Super Stage along with major series such as One Piece, My Hero Academia, Demon Slayer , and more. Jump Festa is the largest annual convention held by Shueisha, as it focuses on new announcements for anime, manga, and games, interactive exhibits, and unique merchandise that is often available only at the convention. However, for global fans who can’t visit Tokyo, the most exciting part of this event is waiting for all the new anime information that is announced each year. Now that Season 4 and a new movie have been announced, fans can expect more updates regarding the anime’s future during the convention. We might get a new visual, release window, and even a teaser during the event since the latest announcement only revealed one key visual and nothing else.

2) Spy x Family Season 4 and Movie Will Be Released in 2027

While the anime hasn’t revealed an exact release date or even the season when the new season will premiere, at the very least, fans won’t have to wait for much longer. Along with the fourth season, even the new movie will be released next year, which means 2027 might be the biggest year for Spy x Family fans. The fourth season is expected to land on Crunchyroll, where you can catch up with the rest of the series. The anime is also available on Netflix, but it won’t be streaming Season 4 outside of Japan during the time of its airing. However, things will be different for the theatrical movie since it will first hit the Japanese theatres before making an international debut. The anime also needs to confirm whether the movie will directly land on the streaming platforms or have a theatrical release in the U.S. before getting a streaming license.

1) Season 4 Will Reveal the Most Shocking Truth in the Anime So Far

The upcoming season will be more exciting than ever, as it is expected to adapt the Term Finals, Love and War, and Term Break Arcs, each offering its own set of plot twists and heartbreaking moments. However, since the episode count hasn’t been revealed yet, it’s impossible to determine how many arcs will be covered in the sequel season. Without spoiling much, we can say that the Term Break Arc is by far the most important part of the story, where it will reveal a shocking truth about a crucial character. The story has already taken a huge turn in the latest season after it shed light on Loid’s past and the reason why he is so dedicated to his work as a spy. However, the story has yet to answer many questions regarding Anya’s past, her involvement in Project Apple, and the powerful figures working behind the scenes.

What are you most excited to see in Spy x Family Season 4? What do you hope will happen next in the lives of the Forger family? Share your thoughts in the comments below!

title: My Death Flags Show No Sign of Ending Novels Get TV Anime in 2027
content:
Manga Box announced on Tuesday a television anime adaptation of Izumi 's My Death Flags Show No Sign of Ending ( Ore no Shibō Flag ga Todomaru Tokoro o Shiranai ) light novel series, which will debut in 2027. The manga adaptation's artist Mitsuya Otosu also drew an illustration to commemorate the announcement:

One Peace Books releases the manga adaptation in English under the title My Death Flags Show No Sign of Ending , and describes the story:

Normal college student Kazuki Hirasawa finds himself inside the body of Harold Stokes, an evil character in the world of Kazuki's favorite game, Brave Hearts. The problem is, if the game's events go as they should, he'll one day find himself defeated by the hero's party. Will he be able to find a path to survival and avoid his many death flags using the incredible power of Harold Stokes's body and his own knowledge of the game? Join Harold in this magnificent manga adaptation of the work that won the 3rd Shosetsuka ni Naro Contest.

Izumi launched the original story on the Shōsetsuka ni Narō website in 2014. Takarajimasha started publishing the light novel series with illustration by Atiki ( Achiki ) in 2015, after it won the grand prize at the "3rd Narō-Con Grand Prix" also in 2015. The fifth novel volume will ship on December 11.

Otosu launched the manga on the Manga Box smartphone app in 2020. Manga Box will publish the manga's 13th compiled book volume digitally on November 29.

The series has over 1.75 million copies in circulation as of October.

title: Izumi Miyazono's 'Kekkon Shimashō, Koi Suru Mae ni' Manga Gets Live-Action 'Short' Drama
content:
The magazine's January 2027 issue will announce more details about the drama next month.

The manga centers on a girl named Natsuki, an office worker who is looking for a boyfriend and wants to get married eventually, and the office's elite lawyer who claims he is not interested in love. Something about the lawyer attracts Natsuki closer, and the love battle begins.

Miyazono launched the manga in Petit Comic in October 2022. Shogakukan published the manga's 10th compiled book volume on July 9.

Miyazono launched the Fumin Fukyū de Yume to ka Koi to ka (Dreams and Love in Insomnia) manga in Petit Comic in June 2021. The manga ended in August 2022. Shogakukan published the manga's second and final compiled book volume in September 2022.

Miyazono launched the Everyone's Getting Married ( Totsuzen desu ga, Ashita Kekkon shimasu ) manga in Petit Comic in April 2014, and ended it in May 2018. Shogakukan published nine compiled book volumes for the manga. Viz Media released the entire manga in North America. The manga inspired a live-action television series in 2017.

title: After the Anime’s Success, A Classic Shojo Confirms Live-Action Series Is Coming Next
content:
Hana-Kimi is commemorating its 30th anniversary with a live-action series and a stage play. While the anime’s future remains uncertain, the franchise only keeps increasing in popularity after being underrated outside of Japan. For several decades now, the anime and manga industry has been heavily dominated by the Shonen demographic, which is why most of the mainstream series are purely battle action. Even the majority of the best-selling manga of all time are also Shonen, including One Piece, Naruto, Dragon Ball, Demon Slayer, and many more. On the other hand, while most Shojo series often fall behind in global recognition, they always offer some of the most unique stories fans have ever seen.

The 1990s weren’t only a phenomenal decade for Shonen, but the Shojo demographic also thrived during that time with the release of some of the best classics that are appreciated to this day. Unfortunately, despite receiving critical acclaim, many such series never received an anime adaptation or took decades to be introduced to fans . Written and illustrated by Hisaya Nakajo, Hana-Kimi began serialization in Hakusensha in 1996 and reached its conclusion in 2004. To date, the franchise has released plenty of projects like drama CDs and a live-action drama, and it continues to expand its reach thanks to new adaptations.

When Is Hana-Kimi ‘s New Live-Action Coming Out?

Comic Natalie confirmed that the eight-episode series will premiere on the NTV channel on December 5th, 2026, at 2:30 p.m. JST (12:30 a.m. EST). Each episode will run for around half an hour, featuring the story from Nakajo’s beloved manga. The series will stream in Japan on streaming services TVer and Hulu. However, international fans still await a release date, and there’s been no information on whether the live-action will stream outside of Japan. Additionally, Keisuke Shibata and NTV’s Shiori Ueno are serving as the director while Fumie Koga, Yuka Arai, and Kazumi Ōki will provide the scripts, with composition done by Yōko Tamura.

On the other hand, Shintarō Sugano will be writing and directing the stage play with the same cast members as the drama. The stage play will take place from February 13th to 15th, 2027, in Osaka after the drama reaches its conclusion. It will also move to Aichi on February 18th and 19th, as well as Tokyo from March 13th to 22nd of the same year. Comic Natalie also revealed the cast members, including Hana Kawamura as Mizuki Ashiya, The Rampage member Makoto Hasegawa as Izumi Sano, another The Rampage member Itsuki Fujiwara as Shūichi Nakatsu, and many more.

What’s Next for Hana-Kimi Anime?

While the franchise has huge plans for its 30th anniversary, there’s been no mention of the anime’s sequel season . The second season aired in the Summer 2026 anime season and reached its conclusion in September this year. While several weeks have already passed, fans have no clue if the anime will ever return with a sequel. Not to mention that it’s pretty common for Shojo adaptations to become forgotten over the years. This fan-favorite series centers around Mizuki Ashiya, who became completely enamored by Izuki Sano after seeing him at a high jump competition. She moved from the United States to Japan and enrolled in the same institute as him. However, Izumi has to go to an all-boys school, which is why Mizuki crossdresses as a boy in order to fit in.

Head down to the comments to tell us if you are excited for the new live-action adaptation of Hana-Kimi or if it should have an anime sequel instead?

title: Kodama Tales Licenses A Mandala in Flames, Baki Hanma, Neo Cat Manga
content:
The publisher Kodama Tales announced the following manga licenses on Monday:

Rejected as an apprentice by the celebrated Kano Eitoku, painter Hasegawa Tohaku struggles to establish himself in Kyoto. When he risks his life to see Eitoku's masterpieces inside a burning castle, his ambition is rekindled. Against the upheaval of sixteenth-century Japan, Tohaku fights for recognition while confronting the losses that will shape his art. Chie Shimomoto's complete, one-volume historical drama imagines the turbulent life of one of Japan's great painters.

Yujiro Hanma is the strongest creature on Earth. His son intends to take that title from him. In the third arc of Keisuke Itagaki 's legendary martial arts saga, Baki seeks out opponents who defy every limit of human strength, from the prison powerhouse Biscuit Oliva to the prehistoric warrior Pickle. Each confrontation brings him closer to the battle fans have been waiting for. Every punch, every broken bone, every impossible victory has led to this.

They walk on two legs, hold down jobs, and even work in host clubs. In Aoka's world, cats participate in human society while remaining unmistakably feline. Across eight offbeat stories, humans and cats work together, clash, and discover unexpected connections. Expressive feline characters and stylishly drawn human settings bring this strange shared world to life, with humor that finds fresh possibilities in our fascination with cats.

title: ghost – end of night Anime Film's Trailer Confirms More Cast & Staff, Theme Song
content:
Bandai Namco Filmworks presented the full trailer, the second key visual, additional cast and staff members, and the theme song for ghost – end of night ( ghost/yoru no hate ), Shingo Natsume and Madhouse 's new theatrical anime project, on Tuesday. The trailer previews the theme song "life" by hitsujibungaku .

The additional cast members include:

Takeo Ōtsuka as Bora, Neekei's predecessor who loves beautiful things

Kazuhiro Yamaji as Ahab, an elderly homeless man who hates the world

Yūki Shin as Structure, a man who possesses special privileges like Neekei

Hina Yomiya as MIke, a girl afraid of being selected

Atsumi Tanezaki as Masu's son

The additional staff members include:

• Costume Styling: Mana Yamamoto

• Costume Design: Kana Itō

• Tattoo Design: Mine Moea

• Assistant Director: Keita Nagasaka

• Compositing Director of Photography, Video Direction: Akane Fushihara

• Action Animator: Gōsei Oda

• In-Between Check: Akane Ōguchi

• Art Director: Yukiko Maruyama

• Color Key Artist: Ayaka Nakamura

• CG Visual Programmer: Kezzardrix

• Editor: Kashiko Kimura

• Sound Director: Shōji Hata

• Sound Effects: Noriko Izumo

• Music: Ōzora Kimishima

Bandai Namco Filmworks describes the film's story:

I want to know what is ＜real＞. Set in the near future where labor is no longer necessary, this is the story of Neekei, a girl who continues seeking the “real” while resisting the order of a content society.

Mayu Hotta stars as Neekei and Issei Takahashi plays Masu ( Character name romanization not official ).

Shingo Natsume ( ACCA: 13-Territory Inspection Dept. , One-Punch Man , Sonny Boy , Space Dandy ) is both directing the anime at Madhouse and penning the script. Manga creator Natsume Ono ( ACCA 13-Territory Inspection Department , Ristorante Paradiso , House of Five Leaves , Not Simple ) is in charge of the original character designs. Norifumi Kugai ( ACCA: 13-Territory Inspection Dept. , Sonny Boy ) is designing the characters for animation. Bandai Namco Filmworks is distributing the film. Alternative rock band hitsujibungaku also performs the film's insert song "Sugar."

The film will open in Japan on February 11, 2027. GKIDS , Annecy International Animation Film Festival, Tokyo International Film Festival, and Variety's Animation is Film festival, which took place on October 16-19, screened the film.

The work marks Shingo Natsume 's first time directing an original anime film. Natsume said that he is aiming for "a work that could be called fictional but is in tune with our current time and seeks realism."

The film has a manga adaptation by artist himiko , which launched in Kadokawa 's Young Ace magazine on August 4.

title: Atelier Karia Game's Video Previews Story
content:
Koei Tecmo started streaming a new trailer on Monday, introducing the story for Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories , a new game in its Atelier franchise.

Early purchases of the game will include the Noctrem Pioneering Preparation Set with in-game items. Pre-orders for the game will include bonus poses and frames for Photo Mode. The Digital Deluxe Edition and the Ultimate Edition include special in-game items.

The Premium Box includes the artbook, a set of posters, extra music tracks, and a special costume for Karia.

The company describes the game:

Reawaken the past, savor the present. A vast fantasy alchemy RPG of memories and discovery. This entry in the Atelier series focuses on tying in alchemy to deepen every aspect of the game. Synthesized items can now be used for more than just combat. They will assist you during exploration and base-building, and will help shape the very path of your adventure. Karia can also eat synthesized items to change both her appearance and abilities. Synthesize items, use them on your adventure, and eat them. This cycle will tie everything together in this new evolution of the Atelier series.

The Atelier Resleriana: The Red Alchemist & the White Guardian ( Kurenai no Renkinjutsushi to Shiro no Shugosha: Resleriana no Atelier ) game launched in the West for PS5, Nintendo Switch, and PC via Steam in September 2025. The game launched for the same systems plus PlayStation 4 in Japan on the same day.

title: One Piece Changes Forever With Luffy’s Surprising New Transformation
content:
One Piece has been on a journey of introducing new transformations, especially since the series began featuring the climax of its battles, and the latest chapter also sees Luffy gaining a new transformation. The arrival of the God’s Knights made it clear that Luffy would have to use his Conqueror’s Haki in a specific way to defeat them. However, with Imu also emerging in the fight, Luffy has been struggling to hold his own. For the first time since unlocking Gear 5, Luffy was defeated brutally, with Gaban even having to intervene to save him from the villain.

Gaban was even adamant about Luffy and his crew escaping the island. However, Luffy remained determined to fight. It was heavily implied that Luffy would overcome this challenge, much like his sword and shield , Zoro and Sanji, by receiving a Haki upgrade. But it seems the creator isn’t done pushing Luffy’s Devil Fruit to its limits and exploring its connection to the Sun God Nika. For most of the latest chapter, it appears that Luffy has run away from the fight. However, near the end, it is revealed that Luffy has a new transformation, with its power briefly showcased. Its appearance is something no one saw coming, but it also aligns with a particular piece of Nika lore.

One Piece Chapter 1198 Gives Luffy His First New Transformation Since Gear 5

Luffy’s Gear 5 transformation was first revealed in March 2022 in chapter 1044. With the series implying that it represented Luffy’s peak, it was expected that any future upgrades would be heavily related to his Haki. However, the latest chapter sees Luffy undergoing a visual transformation . His appearance is similar to Gear 5, but his entire body has now darkened, with the pattern of his Devil Fruit appearing across it. Meanwhile, his teeth have evolved into monstrous fangs, and Luffy behaves literally like a monkey, with his laughter increasingly resembling monkey-like screeches as he stops speaking altogether.

This appearance emerges as Luffy single-handedly obliterates the nightmare manifestation of the Rain God in a wild and playful manner. It almost makes him seem like a destroyer, which apparently aligns perfectly with another interpretation of the Sun God Nika. At the beginning of this arc, it was revealed that the Sun God Nika has two different interpretations. While some revere him, others see him as a destroyer. When this was first depicted, the series also showed an image of the Sun God Nika that looked remarkably similar to Luffy’s current transformation. Perhaps this is the true form of Luffy’s Devil Fruit, which has now come to fruition.

Whatever this new transformation represents, it is clear that Oda isn’t done introducing new forms for One Piece ‘s main character . Considering that this transformation aligns with the Sun God Nika’s portrayal as a destroyer, it highlights how the creator may have foreshadowed it all along. Going forward, One Piece is likely to unveil more details about this new transformation. If it is a rogue form that could even cause Luffy to hurt his friends, One Piece may feature yet another transformation in the near future, one that allows him to control this form and emerge as something new that surpasses Gear 5 and all his previous transformations.
